_comment: One entry per language of the release. template: release/readme/<code>.txt; file: name inside the zip; changelog: release notes for that language (falls back to CHANGELOG.md if the version is missing). The first entry is the main language of the GitHub release notes.

languages.name: English
languages.install: **Installation:** download `Contrappunto-{VERSION}.zip`, extract the `contrappunto` folder into `Documents/MuseScore4/Plugins/` and enable the plugin under *Plugins → Manage plugins*. When updating, first delete the old folder (even if it is called `Contrappunto` with a capital C). Full instructions in `README.TXT` and in the [Wiki]({WIKI_URL}).

languages.name: Italiano
languages.install: **Installazione:** scarica `Contrappunto-{VERSION}.zip`, estrai la cartella `contrappunto` in `Documenti/MuseScore4/Plugins/` e attiva il plugin da *Plugin → Gestisci plugin*. Se aggiorni, elimina prima la vecchia cartella (anche se si chiama `Contrappunto` con la maiuscola). Istruzioni complete in `LEGGIMI.TXT` e nella [Wiki]({WIKI_URL}).
